statement: Fix β > 1 and let C = P∞ l=2 l−2. For an integer k ≥ 1, draw an integer J ≥ 2 with P(J = l) = l−2 C . Conditional on J, draw k + 1 independent copies Fc,0 J , . . . , Fc,k J of the completed free energy in (1.3). Set t = log J, Pk = k Y i=1 J−1/6 (Fc,0 J − Fc,i J ). Conditional averaging over the independent comparison copies gives E[Pk | J = l] = EY k l . The constants in Theorem 1.2 satisfy ak = C ∞ X h=0 E " Pk th h! − 1{h≥1} th−1 (h − 1)! !# , (1.6) where the second term is absent for h = 0. Each expectation is taken before the series is summed.
